query:
-- Statistiques globales
SELECT 
  'Total recettes' as metric, 
  COUNT(*) as value 
FROM recettes
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Total molécules', 
  COUNT(*) 
FROM molecules
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Total liaisons', 
  COUNT(*) 
FROM molecules_recettes
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Recettes avec molécules', 
  COUNT(DISTINCT recette_id) 
FROM molecules_recettes;
